stories.title: HMRC urges customers not to ignore Simple Assessment letters
stories.summary: HMRC is reminding taxpayers that Simple Assessment letters are part of a routine annual process; working-age customers began receiving letters from 30 June 2026, with pensioners to follow from 12 August 2026.

stories.title: AI age-assessment tool will lead to more child refugees being treated as adults, charity warns
stories.summary: A charity has warned that the Home Office's use of an AI facial-age-estimation tool risks wrongly classifying child refugees as adults, raising safeguarding concerns.

stories.title: FCDO statement on democratic governance, civic space and human rights in Nicaragua
stories.summary: The FCDO, together with Chris Elmore MP, issued a statement addressing concerns over democratic governance, civic space and human rights conditions in Nicaragua.

stories.title: Government recognises Southampton's clean air progress
stories.summary: DEFRA confirmed that Southampton has met the annual legal limit for nitrogen dioxide, recognising the city's progress on improving air quality under the Environment Act.

stories.title: UKDI launches new cycle of Innovation Support to Operations
stories.summary: UK Defence Innovation (UKDI), funded by the Ministry of Defence, has launched Cycle 8 of its Innovation Support to Operations competition, seeking cost-competitive, manufacturable proposals.

stories.title: Pay rise for Royal Fleet Auxiliary personnel supporting Royal Navy operations
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence, with Minister Calvin Bailey MBE MP, announced a pay rise for Royal Fleet Auxiliary personnel who support Royal Navy operations.

stories.title: PM brings new hope for justice, nuclear test veteran says
stories.summary: John Morris, who witnessed 1950s nuclear tests, says PM Andy Burnham's backing for an independent inquiry offers new hope for justice for veterans.

stories.title: Why manufacturers are choosing Shropshire to invest and grow
stories.summary: A new video, funded by the Department for Business and Trade, features Bridgnorth Aluminium and other manufacturers explaining why they are investing and growing in Shropshire.

stories.title: New chair announced for North West London Acute Provider Group
stories.summary: Dame Alwen Williams has been appointed as the new chair in common for all four NHS trusts in the North West London Acute Provider Group.
